decision: 5 second time penalty. 1 penalty point (total of 1 for the 12 month period).
fact: Car 31 forced Car 18 off the track on the approach to Turn 4.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. The driver of Car 31 defended his position to Car 18 and moved back towards the racing line on the approach to Turn 4 with Car 18 being alongside on the outside. Car 31 did not leave sufficient space on the outside and forced Car 18 off track.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 31 Forcing Another Driver Off The Track
to: The Team Manager, MoneyGram Haas F1 Team
